title: Intelligence Senior Sergeant
raw_text:
10-35Z. MOS 35Z-- Intelligence Senior Sergeant, CMF 35
   a. Major duties.
        (1) MOSC 35Z5O. The Intelligence Master Sergeant leads, manages, and trains
company and battalion level intelligence activities; they will be able to operate as part of an
Army modular component at the service, joint, inter-agency, inter-governmental, and multi-
national levels on intelligence operations. Provides oversight and experience inclusive of all
aspects of the Intelligence Warfighting Functions. Manages intelligence readiness, the
intelligence cycle and empowers the intelligence enterprise through organizational expertise and
operational guidance in the areas of All Source, CI, SIGINT, HUMINT, GEOINT, intelligence
systems maintenance and intelligence support to the Cyber Domain at all echelons.
Synchronizes intelligence efforts with operational requirements to achieve unit of effort to meet
the commander’s intent. Reviews, evaluates, prepares, and executes intelligence asset
deployment, employment, and redeployment. Compares intelligence TOE and TDA
authorizations and recommends revisions per the Commander’s mission. Supervises and
oversees the implementation of the Intelligence Architecture, to include the conduct of Military
Intelligence systems maintenance and test operations. Success in this MOS requires
demonstrated expertise in a variety of progressive assignments including leadership, key billet
and staff positions at the strategic, operational, and tactical levels.
        (2) MOSC 35Z6O. The Intelligence Sergeant Major enables mission command by serving
as the principle enlisted advisor at the service, joint, inter-agency, inter-governmental, and multi-
national levels on intelligence operations in support of multidomain operations. Provides
oversight and experience inclusive of all aspects of the Intelligence Warfighting Function.
Manages intelligence readiness, the intelligence cycle and empowers the intelligence enterprise
through operational guidance and technical expertise in the areas of All Source, CI, SIGINT,
HUMINT, GEOINT, intelligence systems maintenance and intelligence support to cyber at all
echelons. Synchronizes intelligence efforts with operational requirements to achieve unity of
effort and meet the commander’s intent. Reviews, evaluates, prepares, and executes
intelligence asset deployment, employment and redeployment. Compares intelligence MTOE
and TDA authorizations and recommends revisions. Supervises and oversees the
implementation of Intelligence Architecture, to include the conduct of Military Intelligence
systems maintenance and test operations. Success in this MOS requires demonstrated
expertise in a variety of progressive assignments including leadership, key billet and staff
positions at the strategic, operational, and tactical levels.
   b. Physical demands rating and qualifications for initial award of MOS. Intelligence Senior
Sergeants must possess the following qualifications:
        (1) Physical demands rating of moderate (Gold).
        (2) A physical profile of 222221.
        (3) Normal color vision.
        (4) Minimum score in aptitude area--N/A.
        (5) U.S. citizen.
        (6) The Soldier must meet Top Secret Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS//SCI)
access eligibility requirements to be hold this MOS, a Counterintelligence Scope Polygraph
(CSP) examination and periodic updates may be required depending on assignment.
        (7) 35Zs that do not meet CI Polygraph, FNA or MAD requirements regarding specific
35Z positions that require system or facility access related to the aforementioned items. Are still
eligible to hold MOS 35Z, however they may not be able to acquire the proper clearance or
access needed at certain locations.
        (8) Maintain career management and development criteria contained in AR 614-200
(para 6-3).
        (10) This MOS is closed for reclassification into the MOS except for the normal career
progression of Soldiers in the following MOS’s 35F, 35G, 35L, 35M, 35N, 35P, 35S, or 35T
through promotion.
   c. Additional skill identifiers (ASIs). (Note: Refer to table 12-8 (Listing of universal ASI’s
associated with all enlisted MOS)).
       (1) 1A-- JSTARS E8-A Systems Operator.
       (2) K2- Advanced Communications Signals Analysis.
       (3) M9--Master Driver Trainer (skill level 5 only) (Effective 202610).
       (4) R7--Army Reconnaissance (Skill level 3 and above personnel only).
       (5) V3--Aerial ISR (Intelligence Surveillance and Reconnaissance) Precision Guidance
Operator.
   d. Physical requirements and standards of grade (SG). Physical requirements and SG
relating to each skill level are listed in the following tables:
       (1) Table 10-35Z-2. Standards of grade TOE/MTOE.
       (2) Table 10-35Z-1. Physical requirements.
       (3) Table 10-35Z-3. Standards of grade TDA.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
